top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a child was left unattended, the caregiver was not at a physical proximity that allowed visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: No diaper changing tables wwere observed in the infant and toddler's rooms.

top_violation_types.title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current gas inspection on file.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Director did not ensure that  employees complied with the minimum standards in the infant room on multiple  occasions.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Listing (26 TAC §742.403(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not verified liability insurance.
